image_description: A black and white photograph showing the interior of a prison cell block. The perspective looks down a central corridor flanked by cells with vertical iron bars on both the left and right sides. The ceiling is arched, featuring a hanging cage-like light fixture in the foreground and a bright light source at the far end of the hall. The floor appears to be concrete or stone. The atmosphere is stark and utilitarian.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the scene is correctly classified as a prison/correctional facility interior and not a generic dungeon or basement.
To verify the structural integrity of the long corridor, ensuring the vanishing point and parallel lines of the cell bars are geometrically consistent.
To check if the vertical bars are continuous, distinct entities without melting into the frames or background, a common AI artifact in repetitive structures.

focus_areas: Continuity and straightness of vertical cell bars
Geometric consistency of the arched ceiling and floor perspective
